clues.text: On the first day of Israel's seven-day bread feast, every family had to remove it from the house.
Driven out of Egypt in haste, the Israelites baked the dough they carried without it.
The law given through Moses said no grain offering burned to the LORD could contain it, or honey.
God's law told Israel to bring two loaves of firstfruits baked with it as a wave offering to the LORD.
Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like this, which a woman mixed into three measures of flour.
Jesus warned His disciples to beware this of the Pharisees, and He said it was hypocrisy.
Writing to the Galatians, Paul warned that just a little of it works through the whole batch of dough.
